== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on English [[Luke Seeker]] and [[Luke Seeker (PC Errata)]]. Columns are Original and PC Errata (Appendix A) only. Glossary Supplement 29 January 2002 has an intermediate "Luke of ability < 4" replacement that was not dested as a third column. Do not add Unlimited, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
